import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import results_table


def test_sv4ci01_compositional():
    e = ET.fromstring(results_table.render([{'name': 'b', 'status': 'pass', 'ms': 3}, {'name': 'c', 'status': 'fail', 'ms': 5}, {'name': 'a', 'status': 'pass', 'ms': 1}]))
    rows = e.find('tbody').findall('tr')
    assert [r.find('td').text for r in rows] == ['c', 'a', 'b'] and rows[0].get('class') == 'row-fail'
    assert e.find('tfoot').find('tr').find('td').text == '2/3 passed'

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import results_table


def test_sv4ci01_negative():
    e = ET.fromstring(results_table.render([]))
    assert e.find('tbody').findall('tr') == [] and e.find('tfoot').find('tr').find('td').text == '0/0 passed'

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import results_table


def test_sv4ci01_boundary():
    e = ET.fromstring(results_table.render([{'name': 'x<y', 'status': 'skip', 'ms': 0}]))
    cells = e.find('tbody').find('tr').findall('td')
    assert cells[0].text == 'x<y' and cells[2].text == '0 ms'
    assert e.find('tfoot').find('tr').find('td').text == '0/1 passed'

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import queue_view


def test_sv4ci02_compositional():
    e = ET.fromstring(queue_view.render(['a', 'b', 'c'], 2))
    items = e.findall('li')
    assert [i.get('class') for i in items[:3]] == ['job running', 'job running', 'job waiting']
    assert items[-1].get('class') == 'summary' and items[-1].text == '2 running, 1 waiting'
